page: UpCloud CLOUDNATIVE-2xCPU-8GB is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 7542 processor running at 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 2 vCPUs allocated on a shared basis, 2 physical cores, and 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, and it includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate an entry-level profile. The shared CPU allocation results in poor stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU performance, placing in the bottom 10% of benchmarks. Memory bandwidth is weak, with read-only large block speeds at 27.8 GB/sec and write speeds at 25.1 GB/sec. However, single-threaded tasks show moderate capability, with average ratings in gzip compression at 24.0 GB/sec and Geekbench single-core scores of 1934.0.

From a resource density and cost perspective, this server represents a budget-friendly option for workloads that do not require dedicated CPU resources or high-speed local storage. It is suitable for lightweight applications, basic web serving, text processing, and development or testing environments where resource demands are bursty or minimal.
